att_hyperactivation.definition: The rising of the alarm when a partner seems unavailable, which sharpens attention and speeds the urge to act.
att_hyperactivation.example: Hyperactivation turned three unanswered messages into an hour of checking the phone.

cognitive_load.definition: The total amount of mental effort being used by working memory at one time.

war_clausewitz.definition: The Prussian officer (1780-1831) who wrote On War, the book that gave the field its central sentence.
war_clausewitz.example: Clausewitz wrote that war is the continuation of politics by other means.
